evals.prompt: Add password strength meter to signup form. Follow TDD and include tests.
evals.expected_output: Creates failing tests first, implements minimal feature, adds unit+UI coverage, and updates snapshots intentionally.

evals.prompt: Fix bug where tapping Save twice submits duplicate requests in profile screen.
evals.expected_output: Starts with failing regression tests, applies minimal fix, validates with unit/UI tests, and handles snapshot updates if changed.

evals.prompt: Refactor theme toggle component and ensure tests are complete.
evals.expected_output: Uses Red-Green-Refactor, keeps behaviour stable with unit/UI tests, updates snapshots only when intentional, asks before the device run, then runs the Appium suite and checks the per-test screenshots and visual-regression diff.

evals.prompt: add a 'show password' eye toggle to the login password field, and give me a video proving it works on the emulator
evals.expected_output: Failing UI test first, implements the toggle with a testID, adds positive (toggle reveals/hides) and negative E2E cases to login.e2e.ts via the LoginScreen page object, confirms Node 22/device/Metro, asks before the device run, runs with RECORD_VIDEO=1, turns the new video into a frame strip with contact-sheet.sh and reports what the frames show, adds a reviewed baseline for the new test, commits.

evals.prompt: the home screen got longer after adding the MMKV list. make sure the e2e tests actually scroll to the bottom like a user and check the logout button still works, include positive cases
evals.expected_output: Uses swipe() from helpers/gestures.ts (W3C drag, visible in video) rather than only UiScrollable; asserts scroll via element position change and that the bottom content became reachable; scrolls before tapping logout; groups positive/negative cases; reviews the swipe marker in the recording; handles flattened-XPath and clipped-bounds quirks if they appear.
